title: Oscar and the Safehouse
author: Ansel Brightwater
blurb: August Thornbury, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
